_comment: Carry destination for the routing audit (#2733): the two items the
R10-RCA-FRICTION-RESIDUE record leaves to it. #2733's only roster groups
(R10-ORCH-ROSTER-SCHEMA, R10-ROUTING-INVARIANTS) are done or absorbed, so
no live group's brief can hold them. Shape and required fields:
stage: the routing audit: every open issue but #201 is listed by a live roster group, and every carry routes to a group that is not done

carries.from: R10-RCA-FRICTION-RESIDUE (handoff/r10-rca-friction-residue): the root-cause record for the five recurring-friction keys
carries.control: Established by measurement with its null control, read from the roster file dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json at this PR's merge base. Issue #2875 (the root-cause-detectable friction key) is listed in the `issues` or `fixes` of no group, live or done; the null control is #2860, the regression key, which R10-FRICTION-REGRESSION lists. The perturbation is adding 2875 to any live group's `issues`, after which the same read lists it.
carries.remeasure: Do not trust this paragraph's reading: it is the roster at this PR's merge base and the stage is judged against its own. Re-read the newest roster, list the groups whose issues or fixes include 2875, and if one now does, the finding is void there.
carries.brief: #2875 is an open friction issue that no roster group lists, so invariant 3 of the routing audit is violated for it. The routing audit's subject is to give it an owner: a root-cause group in the shape of R10-FRICTION-REGRESSION, or a recorded disposition of the key, and then to confirm the open-issue check no longer reports it.

carries.from: R10-RCA-FRICTION-RESIDUE (handoff/r10-rca-friction-residue): the record's disposition of the #2855 friction key
carries.control: Established by measurement with its null control, read from the same roster file. Issue #2855 (the carry-missing friction key) is listed only by R10-RCA-FRICTION-RESIDUE, whose stage is queued; the null control is #2733, listed by a not-done group. The perturbation is setting that group done, after which #2855 is listed by a done group alone and the open-issue check reports it.
carries.remeasure: Do not trust this paragraph's reading: re-read the newest roster and list the stage of every group that lists 2855. If a live group other than R10-RCA-FRICTION-RESIDUE lists it, or the issue is closed, the finding is void there.
carries.brief: The record disposes #2855's key, but the mechanism that keeps a disposed key from stranding is the routing audit's. When R10-RCA-FRICTION-RESIDUE is set done while #2855 is open, the issue is listed by a done group alone; the routing audit owns either closing it on the record's disposition or re-listing it with a live group, so that the open-issue check does not report it.
